home_steps_title: From conversation to medical record in four steps
step1_desc: Captures the consultation, only with consent: microphone, video call tab or a pasted transcript.
step2_desc: The audio becomes text, with doctor and patient separated.
step3_desc: In seconds, the text becomes the anamnesis, each section with the consultation sentence that grounds it.
home_features_title: Built for the exam room, not the paperwork
feat_trans_desc: KTB captures the consultation audio, stores it, transcribes it, and processes it into a structured draft. The physician uses it as a tool — every field traceable to what was said.
feat_anam_desc: Each field shows the confidence and the source sentences. You review the text without re-listening to the consultation.
feat_review_desc: You edit each section, check the evidence, and approve. Nothing enters the record without your ok.
feat_privacy_desc: LGPD by architecture, not by disclaimer: explicit patient consent on every consultation, audio under the physician's control, and the option to run 100% in your environment.
feat_privacy_p3: On-premise possible, synthetic data in the demo
home_context_note: Every consultation becomes lasting context. The next one already starts with the history on screen.
faq1_q: How is my consultation audio handled?
faq1_a: Audio is captured only after explicit patient consent and is processed to produce the draft. Transcription can run locally or on the server, always under your control; you can also point to your own model (including a local one via Ollama) to keep everything in your environment.
faq2_q: Does the AI diagnose or prescribe?
faq2_a: No. KTB Health generates a structured draft from what was said in the consultation. Each field shows the confidence and the source sentences, and the final record is always reviewed and approved by a physician. KTB is a tool, not a decision-maker: the physician holds total decision.
faq3_q: Does it work for teleconsultations and in-person visits?
faq3_a: Yes. We start with telemedicine because remote capture is simpler: the bot joins Meet, Zoom, Teams, and WhatsApp Web calls, or you can capture the browser tab audio directly. In-person consultations are a core part of the vision — we are extending the same ambient capture to the consultation room.
faq4_a: Every consultation requires an explicit declaration that the patient was informed and consented to the recording. The consent record stays linked to the consultation and the generated anamnesis.
faq5_q: Can I choose which AI model to use?
faq5_a: Yes. Extraction supports Anthropic, OpenAI, Cloudflare Workers AI, local Ollama, and a heuristic fallback engine. The choice is configuration, not code.

hero_doctors_subtitle: Talk to the patient, not to the screen. KTB Health listens to the consultation, transcribes it and structures the anamnesis with evidence citations. You review, edit and sign.
hero_patients_subtitle: Recording only starts with your explicit consent. The audio stays under your doctor's control, and nothing enters your record without their review and signature.
hero_developers_subtitle: A TypeScript monorepo where transcription and model providers are adapters behind ports, and every domain ships as a plugin. Run it in the cloud or in your own environment.
hero_business_subtitle: Physicians spend 49% of the office day on records and desk work and only 27% with patients. KTB Health gives that time back, with documentation-only positioning and LGPD by architecture.
foryou_doctors_p1: In person, by teleconsultation or by phone, without changing your workflow.
foryou_doctors_p2: Every anamnesis field shows the consultation sentence that grounds it.
foryou_doctors_p3: You review, edit and sign. Nothing enters the record without you.
foryou_patients_p1: Recording only starts after your explicit consent.
foryou_patients_p2: The audio stays under your doctor's control.
foryou_patients_p3: KTB Health never diagnoses or decides your treatment: your doctor does.
foryou_developers_p1: Model providers are swappable configuration: Anthropic, OpenAI, Cloudflare Workers AI, local Ollama or a heuristic engine.
foryou_developers_p2: Every domain is a plugin that owns its routes, views and server functions.
foryou_developers_p3: Run it on-premise, with your own model on your own GPU.
foryou_business_p1: No diagnosis, prescription or clinical decision, in any layer of the product.
foryou_business_p2: Consent on every consultation and LGPD by architecture, not by disclaimer.
foryou_business_p3: Deploy in the cloud or on-premise, inside the hospital.
